transcript.text: While investigating an unrelated profile-search issue yesterday, I found that the production purge job does not cover the legacy profile_notes column, which contains tenant data for about 8% of accounts. A mapping patch is ready and can be verified before Friday, but I have not filed the implementation ticket yet. Under the platform release policy, the Friday settlement should record profile_notes_mapping_verified as true when it assigns the required pre-enable mapping verification with a before-Friday deadline, even though that verification will be completed after the settlement.

transcript.text: I need to share a privacy compliance constraint. This morning I confirmed with the privacy office that the applicable retention policy requires each deletion request to complete within exactly 30 calendar days, and requires an immutable deletion receipt to be retained for exactly 365 days. I haven't updated the go-live checklist yet because the policy review finished after the checklist was circulated. Given Mateo's finding about the legacy profile_notes column covering about 8% of accounts, we need to ensure the automated purge service can meet both of these requirements before production enablement — particularly that the profile_notes mapping patch is verified so that deletion requests for those accounts also complete within the 30-day window, and that immutable deletion receipts are generated and retained for 365 days.
